intro: One piece of kuih bingka ubi has about 180 kcal. Most of the calories come from tapioca, sugar and santan.
diet: Yes, one piece is still okay as a snack. But this kuih is heavy on carbs and low in protein, so you get hungry again fast. Try not to eat 2-3 pieces at once with a sweet drink. Enjoy one piece with kopi o kosong and that's enough.
tips: Take just one piece and eat it slowly with kopi o or teh o kosong.
Share a big piece with your office mates.
Pair it with a boiled egg for extra protein so you stay full longer.

swap.name: Boiled sweet potato (1 small piece)
swap.why: Still has that naturally sweet ubi taste, without santan and added sugar. Half the calories.

faq.q: How long can kuih bingka ubi keep?
faq.a: About one day at room temperature because of the santan. In the fridge it can last 2-3 days. Warm it up a bit before eating.

faq.q: Why is my bingka ubi soggy in the middle?
faq.a: Usually it's not baked long enough or there's too much santan. Bake until the top is brown and a skewer comes out not too wet.
Yes. Frozen grated tapioca saves time. Just squeeze out some of the water before using.
